question: What are the ids of customers who have not made an order?
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "customers" AS SELECT "customer_id" AS "customer_id" FROM table_1;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "orders" AS SELECT "customer_id" AS "customer_id" FROM table_2;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH cust AS (
    SELECT customer_id FROM customers
), ord AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM orders
)
SELECT c.customer_id AS customer_id_without_orders
FROM cust c
LEFT JOIN ord o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.customer_id IS NULL
ORDER BY c.customer_id
LIMIT 100
